33225.a:
| Buyruq | Nima qiladi | Cluster'ga tegadimi |
|---|---|---|
| `helm install` | yangi release; bor bo'lsa xato | ha |
| `helm upgrade --install` | bor bo'lsa yangilaydi, yo'q bo'lsa o'rnatadi — CI uchun idempotent | ha |
| `helm rollback api 3` | 3-revision'ga qaytaradi (yangi revision sifatida) | ha |
| `helm template` | YAML'ni lokal render qiladi | yo'q |

```sh
helm upgrade --install api ./chart -n prod -f values-prod.yaml \
  --set image.tag=1.5.0 --atomic --wait --timeout 5m
helm history api -n prod
helm rollback api 3 -n prod
helm template api ./chart -f values-prod.yaml | kubeconform -strict
helm diff upgrade api ./chart -f values-prod.yaml   # plugin: nima o'zgaradi
```
`--atomic` — muvaffaqiyatsiz bo'lsa avtomatik rollback.

33226.a:
GitOps tamoyillari: holat **deklarativ**, **Git'da** versiyalangan, agent uni **avtomatik tortadi** (pull) va **doimiy reconcile** qiladi.

```
developer -> PR -> config repo (Git)
                      ^ poll / webhook
          ArgoCD (cluster ichida): Git holati vs cluster holati
                      -> farq bo'lsa sync (kubectl apply)
                      -> Health: Healthy / Progressing / Degraded
```
```yaml
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata: { name: api, namespace: argocd }
spec:
  source: { repoURL: https://github.com/acme/deploy, path: apps/api/prod, targetRevision: main }
  destination: { server: https://kubernetes.default.svc, namespace: prod }
  syncPolicy: { automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true } }
```
Foyda: CI'da cluster credential yo'q, har o'zgarish Git tarixida (audit), rollback = `git revert`, qo'lda o'zgartirish (drift) ko'rinadi.

33229.a:
| Sozlama | Nima qiladi | Xavf |
|---|---|---|
| `automated` | Git o'zgarsa o'zi sync | xato commit darhol prod'ga |
| `prune: true` | Git'dan o'chirilgan resursni cluster'dan o'chiradi | noto'g'ri path = resurslar o'chadi |
| `selfHeal: true` | qo'lda (`kubectl edit`) o'zgarishni qaytaradi | incident paytida qo'lda fix ham qaytadi |

```yaml
syncPolicy:
  automated: { prune: true, selfHeal: true }
  syncOptions: [CreateNamespace=true, PruneLast=true]
  retry: { limit: 5, backoff: { duration: 10s, factor: 2 } }
```
Odatiy tanlov: dev/stage — hammasi yoqiq; prod — automated + selfHeal, prune ehtiyotkorlik bilan (yoki manual sync + approval).
Muhim resursga (PVC, namespace): annotation `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options: Prune=false`.
HPA boshqaradigan `replicas` — `ignoreDifferences` ga qo'shing.

33231.a:
```
app repo (kod)  --CI--> image ghcr.io/acme/api:1.5.0
deploy repo (config):
  apps/api/base/
  apps/api/overlays/dev/     image tag 1.5.0   <- CI avtomatik PR/commit
  apps/api/overlays/stage/   image tag 1.4.2   <- promote PR
  apps/api/overlays/prod/    image tag 1.4.2   <- promote PR + approval
clusters/
  prod-eu/  prod-us/         ApplicationSet (cluster generator)
```
- **Promote** = bir xil image digest'ni keyingi muhit papkasiga PR bilan ko'chirish; image qayta build qilinmaydi.
- Avtomatlashtirish: Argo CD Image Updater, Kargo yoki CI'dagi oddiy `yq` + PR.
- ApplicationSet: bitta shablon -> har cluster/muhit uchun Application.
- Muhitlar orasidagi farq faqat overlay/values'da; branch-per-environment — merge konfliktlar va drift sababli tavsiya etilmaydi.

33232.a:
```sh
helm history api -n prod
# REVISION  STATUS           DESCRIPTION
# 11        deployed         Upgrade complete
# 12        pending-upgrade  Preparing upgrade
helm status api -n prod
kubectl get events -n prod --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail
```
Sabablar: CI job o'ldirildi (timeout/cancel), hook Job osildi, `--wait` probe'larni kutib vaqt tugadi.

Tuzatish:
```sh
helm rollback api 11 -n prod      # oxirgi deployed revision'ga
# rollback ham ishlamasa: pending revision secret'ini o'chirish (oxirgi chora)
kubectl get secret -n prod -l owner=helm,name=api
```
Oldini olish: `--atomic --timeout 10m`, CI'da `concurrency` (bitta release'ga bitta deploy), hook'larga `activeDeadlineSeconds`, cancel bo'lganda ham cleanup.

33241.a:
**Qisqa javob:** `--check` — dry run: modullar nima o'zgartirishini aytadi, lekin hech narsa bajarmaydi. `--diff` — fayl va template'lardagi aniq farqni (eski vs yangi) ko'rsatadi. Birga ishlatiladi: prod'ga apply'dan oldin "nima bo'ladi" ni ko'rish.

**Amalda:**
```bash
ansible-playbook site.yml --check --diff --limit web1
# TASK [nginx config] ***
# --- before: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
# +++ after: /home/u/.ansible/tmp/.../nginx.conf.j2
# @@ -3,7 +3,7 @@
# -    worker_connections 1024;
# +    worker_connections 4096;
# changed: [web1]
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
--check:  modul "check mode" ni qo'llab-quvvatlaydimi?
            ha  -> holatni tekshiradi, changed/ok aytadi
            yo'q (command/shell) -> task o'tkazib yuboriladi (skipped)
```

**Nozik joylar:**
```yaml
# check rejimida ham bajarilsin (faqat o'qiydigan task)
- ansible.builtin.command: cat /etc/app/version
  register: ver
  check_mode: false
  changed_when: false

# secret diff'da chiqmasin
- ansible.builtin.template: { src: db.conf.j2, dest: /etc/app/db.conf }
  diff: false
  no_log: true
```

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Oldingi task check'da bajarilmagan bo'lsa (paket o'rnatilmagan), keyingi task "fayl topilmadi" deb yiqiladi — natija noaniq.
- `command`/`shell` check'da o'tkazib yuboriladi — "changed=0" yolg'on xotirjamlik beradi.
- `--diff` parol va kalitlarni ekranga (va CI logiga) chiqaradi — `no_log`/`diff: false`.

**Senior nuqta:** CI'da prod'ga `--check --diff` natijasini PR'ga comment qilish — Terraform plan'ining Ansible ekvivalenti. Uni to'liq kafolat deb emas, review vositasi deb qabul qiling.

33243.a:
```
roles/nginx/
  tasks/main.yml        # asosiy task'lar
  handlers/main.yml     # reload/restart
  templates/nginx.conf.j2
  files/                # statik fayllar
  defaults/main.yml     # o'zgartirsa bo'ladigan default'lar (eng past precedence)
  vars/main.yml         # ichki konstantalar (yuqori precedence)
  meta/main.yml         # dependency, platformalar
```
```yaml
# requirements.yml
roles:
  - { name: geerlingguy.docker, version: 7.4.1 }
collections:
  - { name: community.general, version: ">=9.0.0,<10.0.0" }
  - { name: amazon.aws, version: 8.2.1 }
```
```sh
ansible-galaxy install -r requirements.yml
```
Collection — role, modul va plugin'lar paketi (`amazon.aws.ec2_instance`). Modullarni FQCN bilan yozing: `ansible.builtin.copy`.

33244.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Dynamic inventory — hostlar ro'yxatini statik fayldan emas, manba (AWS, GCP, Azure, VMware, CMDB) API'sidan har run'da olish. Cloud'da serverlar autoscaling bilan doimiy almashadi va IP o'zgaradi — statik fayl darhol eskiradi.

**Muammo:**
```
static inventory: web1=10.0.1.10, web2=10.0.1.11
ASG web1 ni almashtirdi -> yangi IP 10.0.1.37
playbook: web1 UNREACHABLE, yangi server umuman sozlanmadi
```

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
ansible-playbook -i aws_ec2.yml
   -> plugin: ec2:DescribeInstances (filtr: tag env=prod, running)
   -> guruhlar tag'lardan: role_web, role_db
   -> ansible_host = private IP
```

**Amalda:**
```yaml
# inventory/aws_ec2.yml  (fayl nomi *aws_ec2.yml bilan tugashi shart)
plugin: amazon.aws.aws_ec2
regions: [eu-central-1]
filters:
  tag:env: prod
  instance-state-name: running
keyed_groups:
  - { key: tags.role, prefix: role }      # role_web, role_db
hostnames: [private-ip-address]
compose:
  ansible_host: private_ip_address
cache: true
cache_timeout: 300
```
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install amazon.aws
ansible-inventory -i inventory/aws_ec2.yml --graph
# @all:
#   |--@role_web:
#   |  |--10.0.1.37
ansible-playbook -i inventory/aws_ec2.yml site.yml --limit role_web
```
IAM: Ansible ishlaydigan rolga `ec2:DescribeInstances` (va kerak bo'lsa `ec2:DescribeTags`).

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Tag'lar izchil emas (`Role` vs `role`) — host hech qaysi guruhga tushmaydi va jimgina sozlanmaydi.
- Public IP bilan ulanish — bastion/SSM yoki private IP ishlating.
- Cache'siz katta akkauntda har run'da sekin API chaqiruvlar.

**Senior nuqta:** Dynamic inventory'da tag'lar "haqiqat manbai" bo'ladi — ularni Terraform'da majburiy qiling (`default_tags`, validation). Autoscaling uchun yanada yaxshisi — sozlashni image (Packer) yoki boot (`ansible-pull`) ga ko'chirish.

33246.a:
**Qisqa javob:** Counter'ning xom qiymati (`1 543 211`) — jarayon boshlanganidan beri yig'indi; u o'zi hech narsa demaydi va restart'da 0 ga tushadi. `rate()` butun oraliq bo'yicha o'rtacha sekundlik tezlikni beradi (reset'larni to'g'rilaydi) — silliq, alert uchun. `irate()` faqat oxirgi ikki nuqtadan hisoblaydi — tez reaksiya qiladi, lekin tikanli.

**Qanday ishlaydi:**
```
qiymat: 100 ... 400 ... 0 (restart) ... 150
rate:   reset'ni aniqlaydi -> (400-100) + 150 ni oraliqqa bo'ladi
irate:  faqat oxirgi 2 sample: (150 - 0) / 15s
```

**Amalda:**
```promql
rate(http_requests_total[5m])       # 5 daqiqadagi o'rtacha req/s
irate(http_requests_total[5m])      # oxirgi 2 sample asosida
increase(http_requests_total[1h])   # 1 soatdagi o'sish (~ rate * 3600)
sum by (service) (rate(http_requests_total[5m]))   # avval rate, keyin sum
```

| | rate | irate |
|---|---|---|
| Asos | butun oraliq | oxirgi 2 sample |
| Grafik | silliq | tikanli |
| Alert | ha | yo'q |
| Zoom-out | barqaror | qisqa sakrashlarni yo'qotadi |

**Qoidalar:**
- Oraliq kamida 4 x `scrape_interval` (15s -> `[1m]` va ko'proq). Grafana'da `$__rate_interval`.
- Avval `rate`, keyin agregatsiya: `sum(rate(x[5m]))`, teskarisi xato.

**Tuzoqlar:**
- Counter'ni grafikda to'g'ridan ko'rsatish — doim o'suvchi chiziq, foydasiz.
- `irate` bilan alert — bitta sakrash alert'ni yoqib-o'chiradi (flapping).
- `rate` ni gauge'ga qo'llash — ma'nosiz natija; gauge uchun `deriv()`/`delta()`.

**Senior nuqta:** Alert oynasini tanlash — signal va tezlik orasidagi trade-off: `[5m]` + `for: 10m` odatda yaxshi muvozanat; SLO burn-rate alert'lari esa bir nechta oynani birga ishlatadi.

33247.a:
Exporter — o'z metrikasini bermaydigan tizimdan ma'lumot yig'ib, `/metrics` da Prometheus formatida beruvchi jarayon.

| Exporter | Nima uchun | Port |
|---|---|---|
| node_exporter | Linux server: CPU, RAM, disk, tarmoq | 9100 |
| cAdvisor (kubelet ichida) | container resurslari | — |
| kube-state-metrics | K8s obyektlari holati (replicas, pod phase) | 8080 |
| blackbox_exporter | tashqi tekshiruv: HTTP, TCP, ICMP, TLS | 9115 |
| postgres_exporter / redis_exporter / mysqld_exporter | DB metrikalari | 9187 / 9121 / 9104 |
| nginx exporter | ulanishlar, so'rovlar | 9113 |

```sh
curl -s localhost:9100/metrics | grep node_load
```
O'z ilovangiz uchun exporter emas — client library (Go: `prometheus/client_golang`) bilan metrikani to'g'ridan bering.

33250.a:
Prometheus K8s API'dan target'larni topadi (`kubernetes_sd_configs`: pod, service, endpoints, node), `relabel_configs` bilan keraklilarini tanlaydi.

Prometheus Operator (kube-prometheus-stack) bilan deklarativ:
```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
  name: api
  labels: { release: kube-prometheus-stack }   # Prometheus shu label'li SM'larni oladi
spec:
  selector: { matchLabels: { app: api } }       # qaysi Service
  namespaceSelector: { matchNames: [prod] }
  endpoints:
  - { port: http-metrics, path: /metrics, interval: 30s }
```
- ServiceMonitor — Service orqali; PodMonitor — Service'siz pod'lar uchun.
- Target ko'rinmasa: Prometheus UI -> Status -> Targets / Service Discovery; ko'pincha `release` label yo'q yoki port **nomi** mos emas.

33254.a:
```
EC2 instance profile (IAM role) -> IMDS (169.254.169.254) -> vaqtinchalik credential (soatlab aylanadi)
                                       -> AWS SDK avtomatik oladi
```
Statik access key muammolari: kod/AMI/log'dan oqib ketadi, rotation qo'lda, kim ishlatgani noaniq, server buzilsa abadiy ishlaydi.

```json
{ "Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::acme-uploads/*" }
```
- IMDSv2 majburiy qiling (`HttpTokens=required`) — SSRF orqali credential o'g'irlashni qiyinlashtiradi.
- K8s (EKS): IRSA yoki EKS Pod Identity — har pod'ga alohida role, node role'i emas.
- CI (GitHub Actions): OIDC -> `AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity`.
- Tekshirish: `aws sts get-caller-identity` instance ichida.

33255.a:
Zanjir bo'yicha tekshiring:
```
instance (private subnet) -> SG outbound -> NACL -> route table 0.0.0.0/0 -> NAT GW
   NAT GW (public subnet) -> public subnet route 0.0.0.0/0 -> Internet Gateway
```
1. Private subnet route table'da `0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-xxx` bormi.
2. NAT GW **public** subnet'da, `Available` holatida, Elastic IP bilan.
3. Public subnet route table'da `0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx`.
4. SG outbound ruxsat (default — hammasi ochiq).
5. NACL: stateless — chiqish 443 va **kirish 1024-65535** (ephemeral javoblar) ruxsat.
6. DNS: VPC'da `enableDnsSupport`/`enableDnsHostnames`.

```sh
curl -sv https://aws.amazon.com -m 5          # instance ichida (SSM Session Manager orqali)
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters Name=association.subnet-id,Values=subnet-xxx
```
VPC Reachability Analyzer yo'lni avtomatik tekshiradi.

33256.a:
```
Route 53 -> CloudFront (static, cache) -> ALB (3 AZ)
                                          |
              ASG / EKS node'lar: AZ-a  AZ-b  AZ-c   (stateless app)
                     |             ElastiCache Redis (Multi-AZ, sessiya/cache)
                     |             RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ (+ read replica)
                     |             S3 (fayllar)
NAT GW har AZ'da (bitta AZ yiqilsa chiqish to'xtamasin)
```
Asosiy qarorlar:
- App **stateless** — har instance almashtirilishi mumkin; sessiya Redis/DB'da.
- Kamida 2, yaxshisi 3 AZ; bitta AZ yiqilganda qolganlari yukni ko'tara olsin (N+1 sig'im).
- Health check: ALB target, ASG ELB health check, K8s readiness.
- Ma'lumot: RDS Multi-AZ (failover), automated backup + PITR, S3 versioning.
- DR: backup boshqa region'da, IaC bilan muhitni qayta ko'tarish, RTO/RPO kelishilgan va sinalgan.
- Kuzatish: CloudWatch/Prometheus alarm'lar, ALB 5xx, target unhealthy.
